mapper.select: select distinct tt.task_id, tt.user_id, tt.task_title, tt.description, tt.completed, tt.completion_time, tt.urgency_level, tt.start_time, tt.due_date, tt.create_by, tt.create_time, tt.update_by, tt.update_time, tt.deleted, t.tag_name from todo_task tt left join todo_task_tag ttt on ttt.task_id = tt.task_id left join todo_tag t on t.tag_id = ttt.tag_id where tt.task_id = #{id}

select distinct tt.task_id, tt.user_id, tt.task_title, tt.description, tt.completed, tt.completion_time, tt.urgency_level, tt.start_time, tt.due_date, tt.create_by, tt.create_time, tt.update_by, tt.update_time, tt.deleted from todo_task tt
tt.user_id = #{userId} and tt.deleted = 0
and tt.parent_id = #{parentId}
order by tt.due_date desc

select distinct tt.task_id, tt.user_id, tt.task_title, tt.description, tt.completed, tt.completion_time, tt.urgency_level, tt.start_time, tt.due_date, tt.create_by, tt.create_time, tt.update_by, tt.update_time, tt.deleted, t.tag_name from todo_task tt left join todo_task_tag ttt on ttt.task_id = tt.task_id left join todo_tag t on t.tag_id = ttt.tag_id where tt.task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into todo_task (user_id, task_title, description, completed, urgency_level, start_time, due_date, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) values (#{task.userId}, #{task.taskTitle}, #{task.description}, #{task.completed}, #{task.urgencyLevel}, #{task.startTime}, #{task.dueDate}, #{task.createBy}, #{task.createTime}, #{task.updateBy}, #{task.updateTime}, 0)
mapper.update: update todo_task set deleted = 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId}
